nodes.label: MultiCritique Framework
nodes.rationale: Unified framework leveraging multi-agent feedback for critique ability improvement in SFT and RL stages without human annotation; aggregates high-quality critiques via meta-critique mechanism.

nodes.label: MultiCritique-SFT Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multiple LLMs provide fine-grained critiques at sentence and cross-sentence levels; meta-critique judges each unit; final critique aggregates high-quality units while discarding flawed ones.

nodes.label: MultiCritique-RL Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Constructs preference critique pairs based on meta-critique evaluations; validates contributions to revisions across models; retains only pairs where chosen critiques consistently lead to superior revisions.

nodes.label: Meta-Critique Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Communication mechanism that judges each critique unit by referencing multi-agent critiques; enables fine-grained aggregation of high-quality critique components.

nodes.label: CRITICEVAL and CRITICBENCH Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Evaluation benchmarks for critique ability; MultiCritique 7B-8B models achieve 75.66% F1 on CRITICBENCH, approaching 70B LLMs and GPT-4's 78.75%.

nodes.label: Data Efficiency Gains
nodes.rationale: MultiCritique exhibits 2.15-4.22x superior data efficiency compared to baselines; outperforms 7B-13B models trained on 3-8x larger datasets.

nodes.label: Cross-Task Generalization
nodes.rationale: SFT dataset exhibits strong generalization on unseen tasks and enhances general LLM capability; demonstrates robustness beyond critique-specific training.

nodes.label: MultiCritique: Multi-Agent Critique Generation for LLM Critique Ability
nodes.rationale: Core research contribution: proposes a data generation pipeline to improve LLM critique abilities through multi-agent feedback aggregation and reinforcement learning

nodes.label: MultiCritique-SFT Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Three-stage pipeline: (1) Multi-Agent Analytical Critiques from 4 LLMs, (2) Meta-Critique Classification by GPT-4, (3) Critique Aggregation to produce final critique

nodes.label: MultiCritique-RL Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Two-step RL pipeline: (1) Preference Pairs Collection based on meta-critique severity scores, (2) Multi-Agent-Revision-Validating (MARV) to refine preference dataset by validating revision quality

nodes.label: Analytical Critique Unit (ACU)
nodes.rationale: Structured unit with 5 components: location, description, revision suggestions, criteria type, severity. Designed to identify specific flaws in responses

nodes.label: Crucial Information Collection
nodes.rationale: Three components to simplify critique task: (1) Task Description from GPT-4, (2) Customized Two-Tier Evaluation Criteria, (3) Reference Response satisfying all criteria

nodes.label: MultiCritiqueDataset-SFT
nodes.rationale: 32.1K samples with queries, responses, crucial information, and aggregated critiques for supervised fine-tuning

nodes.label: MultiCritiqueDataset-RL
nodes.rationale: 19.7K samples with preference critique pairs for reinforcement learning fine-tuning

nodes.label: Multi-Agent-Revision-Validating (MARV)
nodes.rationale: Validates critique quality by having 4 independent 7B LLMs perform 8 revisions each based on critiques, then evaluates revision quality with reward models

nodes.label: CRITICEVAL Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Evaluates critique ability across 9 tasks with objective/subjective feedback and revision quality metrics

nodes.label: CRITICBENCH Benchmark
nodes.rationale: 3,825 queries across 5 challenging reasoning tasks (math, commonsense, symbolic, algorithm, code) with F1 score evaluation

nodes.label: InternLM2-7B-Chat Model
nodes.rationale: Primary model for fine-tuning experiments, representative of 7B-8B efficient LLMs

hyperedges.label: Multi-Agent Feedback Systems
hyperedges.rationale: Unified framework leveraging multiple LLM agents to improve critique ability: SFT stage aggregates fine-grained multi-agent critiques via meta-critique mechanism; RL stage constructs and validates preference critiques through multi-model revision validation; enables scalable improvement without human annotation.
